podcast.title: A Farts Record Label
podcast.body: In the 1990s, Peter Culman founded his own record label in Germany called "A Farts." The label produced hundreds of works, none of which sold more than 1,000 units. The style of music produced by the label was described as being "ese rollo en el ronque de Gustav Rael." "La discográfica que había fundado en la alemania en los 90 que se ha dado a Farts, produjo, cientos de algo mas pero ninguno de ellos praniamente llevaba a los mil unitades."

podcast.title: Collaborations and Posthumous Recognition
podcast.body: Peter Culman was more widely known for his collaborations with other artists like Brian Eno and Richie Hawtin than for his own musical pieces, partly due to his extensive use of different names. After his death, some of his collaborative works and pieces from alternative projects, previously unreleased or obscure, were made available on Spotify. "hoy lo conocemos por que rajo con muchísimos artistas como Brian Nino, como Richie Houghton mas que por las piezas que hizo él."

podcast.title: Death and Legacy
podcast.body: Peter Culman passed away in 2002 from a heart attack. After his death, his record label went bankrupt. Due to the extremely small print runs of his works (often less than 1,000 units), much of his discography became exceptionally rare, described as "dead on video." While his primary album "60.000" remains elusive, some of his other productions and collaborations have since appeared on streaming platforms. "Murio Nino 2002 por un infarto y su discográfica de robo y prácticamente de todo lo que he dicho era que ha dado un etal de tiradas tan pequeñas que ha muerto en el vídeo."

podcast.title: Early Career and Pseudonyms
podcast.body: Peter Culman was an artist and producer who also owned his own graphic label in the 90s. Although he didn't achieve significant mainstream success outside Germany, his work was considered very interesting. Following a conflict related to his 1993 album and Air's debut, he continued his career under various pseudonyms, with "Pit Nanduke" being the most widely recognized. "Usaba nombres de fases grupos y sobre todo tenían sobre nombre que es Pit Nanduke con el que rateamente todo el mundo lo conoce."
